title: 可覆盖安装测试包需要稳定的调试签名身份
summary: 临时 CI runner 每次生成不同 debug keystore 会让设备把后续测试 APK 视为不同签名应用。快速测试构建应稳定复用 debug signing identity，而生产 release key 必须保持独立私密。
rules: Fast test APK pipelines preserve one stable debug signing identity across builds.
Ephemeral runner-local autogenerated keystores are not treated as persistent app identity.
Release/production signing uses a separate private key and never reuses the debug certificate.
Signing identity is part of upgrade/replace-install test reproducibility.
